question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who speaks more than one language
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Polyglot"** refers to someone who speaks more than one language. (बहुभाषी)

 
 
• **Example: **John is a **polyglot**, fluent in English, Spanish, French, and German.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that someone who speaks more than one language is called a **'polyglot'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Heretic **(नास्तिक): A person who holds beliefs that are contrary to the established doctrines, especially in religion.

 
 
• **Example:** During the medieval period, many were labeled as heretics for their unorthodox views.
 
 
 
• **Fatalist **(नियतिकवादी): A person who believes that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.
 
 
• **Example: **As a fatalist, she believed that everything in life was destined to happen.
 
 
 
• **Insolvent** (दिवालिया): Unable to pay debts owed.
 
 
• **Example:** The company went insolvent after several years of financial struggles.
